notes:
**The way out was the only order in the app that did not pay the spread.** Every one-tap close - the positions screen, the option chain, the chart's close line, the scalper, Safe Exit, the auto square-off - filled exactly on the last traded price, while every entry crossed the spread properly. A scalper doing twenty round trips kept money a real one hands to the market maker, and worse: a strategy whose entries were slipped and whose exits were not read as profitable when the round trip was flat. An expiry settlement is exempt, because a contract ceasing is not a trade against anybody.

**The 3:20pm square-off cancelled stops on the wrong exchange.** Closing one NSE equity position at 3:20 cancelled EVERY open intraday order in the book - including the stop-loss on an MCX crude position that trades until 11pm, and the F&O stops whose positions are deliberately left alive for five more minutes. A stop that cannot stop, cancelled by a rule about a different exchange. It now cancels only the orders belonging to the positions it actually closed. The notification also said "3:20pm cut-off" at eleven at night.
